name: Introductory Data Science
description: AI philosophy; data collection and models; data curation; data quality assessment; data infrastructure; data value; statistical training and hypothesis formation; statistical hypothesis testing; state spaces, local search and optimisation for machine learning; supervised and unsupervised machine learning; regression; decision trees and random forests; neural networks; hyperparameter tuning and performance metrics; model debugging; AI agents and sequential decision-making; application areas; AI/data ethics and social implications; overview of latest advances like large language models; practical assignments in python/R for familiarisation with data science and machine learning libraries, and interpretation of outcomes.
